يستأثر (form X)
# يَسْتَأْثِرُ (yastaʔṯiru) /jas.taʔ.θi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# يُسْتَأْثَرُ (yustaʔṯaru) /jus.taʔ.θa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# يَسْتَأْثِرَ (yastaʔṯira) /jas.taʔ.θi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْثَر
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
